findings.description: The asymmetric support sweep uses an unwrapped angle. At scalp u=0 and u=1 the same physical rear meridian has different positions, leaving a genuine support seam. Long curtain roots can evaluate u>1 and disagree with equivalent wrapped support.

visualObservations: Matched combed hair shows stronger swept occupancy and long hair shows connected side/back volume instead of sparse cheek-height wires.
At normal mobile scale long hair is visibly fuller; the head and beard still look plastic/painted and long ends remain simplified.
Rear seam is established by actual geometry, rather than by the front/profile camera images.
testCorrectionAssessment: The two tests now compare scalp changes with the accepted immediate pre-change face renderer. This is appropriate for current hair isolation because older references precede accepted facial anatomy changes. Original reference files and old golden expectations remain preserved. The tests must not be described as re-executing every historical component comparison.
